_about: Methanol (1) + Water (2): isobaric T-x-y at 101.3 kPa. Rows: liquid mole fraction of methanol, boiling temperature in K, vapour mole fraction of methanol, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: Zhang, Xuemei, Hao, Xin, Yang, Xiaojie, Jian, Chungui, Experimental isobaric vapour-liquid equilibrium data for the binary system (N, N-dimethyl acetamide + dimethyl sulfoxide) and the quaternary system (sec-butyl acetate + sec-butyl alcohol + N, N-dimethyl acetamide + dimethyl sulfoxide) at 101.3 kPa, J. Chem. Thermodyn. 136 (2019) 132-140
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 7, 8. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Consistency point test (Redlich-Kister fit to T-x): mean |dy| 0.0052. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
